ToRequestParam.name: to
ToRequestParam.description: The time in milliseconds from the epoch up to which sensor clients are fetched (the upper bound). Defaults to the present now.

FromRequestParam.name: from
FromRequestParam.description: The time in milliseconds from the epoch after which sensor clients are fetched (the lower bound). Defaults to the previous 30 days. The difference between `from` and `to` is not allowed be greater than 90 days.

MacRequestParam.name: mac
MacRequestParam.description: Filter clients by partial MAC address (case-insensitive).

VendorRequestParam.name: vendor
VendorRequestParam.description: Filter clients by partial vendor/OUI name (case-insensitive).
